roles.title: Senior Analytical Lead, then Analytical Director

requirements.text: Deep, hands-on Amazon experience across both 1P and 3P models.
Demonstrated ownership of measurement for at least two major retail channels, one of which is Amazon or Walmart.
Track record designing and interpreting incrementality tests and reading geographic/DMA-level performance.
Comfortable working directly with data — writing your own SQL queries and building your own views in a BI tool rather than waiting on someone else to pull numbers. Power BI pref…

Python or R for analysis.

8+ years in analytics, with 3+ years leading people, in retail, CPG, e-commerce, or an agency/consultancy serving them.
